# Ananta One — 1 & 2 BHK Homes in Vasai East

> Ananta One is a G+22 residential tower by Setuone and Sokha Realty at Madhuban Hills, Golani Naka, Vasai East, Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra 401208, India. It offers 1 BHK and 2 BHK homes in a standalone gated community with a podium-level swimming pool, rooftop sky garden, gym and neighbourhood shops on the ground floor. MahaRERA Registration No. PM1240002601890.

## Key facts

- Project: Ananta One ("Extraordinary living for extraordinary you")
- Promoters: Setuone (Building Trust, Creating Futures) and Sokha Realty (Homes for Life)
- Architects: Sanat Mehta & Associates; RCC consultant: Bhavin C Shah
- Location: Madhuban Hills, Golani Naka, Vasai East, Vasai-Virar, Maharashtra 401208, India
- Tower: G+22 storeys, 214 homes, 3 passenger lifts + 1 fire lift
- Configurations: 1 BHK (smart starter homes) and 2 BHK (spacious family homes); some layouts include a study
- MahaRERA: PM1240002601890 (https://maharerait.maharashtra.gov.in/project/view/66045)
- Sales enquiries / WhatsApp: +91 91672 87797
- Price: on request (contact sales for the current price sheet)

## Homes (indicative room sizes from the typical floor plan)

- 1 BHK: Living 9'5" × 16'4", Bedroom 9'0" × 10'0", Kitchen 7'8" × 10'0", 2 toilets.
- 2 BHK: Living 16'4" × 9'5", Bedrooms 10'4" × 9'1" and 9'0" × 9'0", Kitchen 9'0" × 7'2".
- Typical floor plan applies to the 3rd–7th, 9th–12th, 14th–18th and 20th–22nd floors.
- RERA carpet areas are available on request.

## Standout features

Elegant entrance lobby with reception desk; 3 passenger lifts + 1 fire/fireman's lift; generator backup for common areas, lifts and water pumps; CCTV surveillance with 24×7 security; visitor management system; rainwater harvesting; branded sanitaryware and CP fittings; modular kitchen.

## Amenities

Lifestyle & wellness: sky/terrace garden, green walkway/fitness track, gymnasium, yoga deck and meditation lawn, swimming pool (podium level).
Leisure & community: stargazing deck, kids' play area, chit-chat corner, reader's lounge, adults' swing, senior citizen corner, gazebo, rooftop garden.
Neighbourhood shops on the ground floor.

## Specifications

Living room: vitrified tiles, corner POP false ceiling, full-height powder-coated aluminium windows, FRD main door, safety-door provision.
Bedrooms: vitrified/wooden flooring, full-height powder-coated aluminium windows, painted flush door, corner false ceiling.
Kitchen: modular kitchen, vitrified tiles, powder-coated aluminium window, exhaust-fan point, ceramic tile backdrop, dual platform, dry balcony.
Bathroom & plumbing: ceramic tile flooring, ceramic tiles up to door height, loft tank provision, branded sanitaryware and fixtures, concealed plumbing.
Electrification: concealed wiring, branded modular switches, inverter provision, ELCB, geyser/fridge/washing machine points, TV and telephone points.

## Location and connectivity

Near Veer Savarkar Road, Gokhivare Road, Ambadi Road, the proposed DP Road, Vasai Flyover and Vasai Road railway station.
Connected today: Western Railway suburban line (Vasai Road to Borivali, Andheri, Dadar, Churchgate); Mumbai–Ahmedabad Highway (NH-48).
Under execution: Virar–Alibaug Multimodal Corridor. Proposed: Metro Line 13 (Vasai–Virar).
